verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say the CLI "outputs JSON in agent mode and is built for scripted loops" and supports scripted or scheduled workflows. Admins can "pull full spend exports", and custom CSV exports exist, so bulk reads and agent-driven iteration over many items are documented. There is no explicit native bulk-action feature such as multi-select approve, bulk edit or a batch API endpoint, so bulk writes depend on agents looping over single-item commands. Missing for 10: documented native bulk or batch write operations (bulk approve, recode or edit), batch API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
